The occupation army provided small arms & some aid to about a dozen rebel factions which were part of the Southern Front — for about 18 months around 2016-2017. 

The Southern Front factions had previously received aid from the US/coalition (as part of Timber Sycamore operation) from 2014 until 2016. When the US decided to pivot to focus solely on combatting ISIS in 2015 they gave the rebel groups receiving aid an ultimatum, either pledge to ONLY combat ISIS, not the regime, or they'd be cut off. Those groups were combatting both, because both were attacking & trying to advance on them. They didnt have the luxury of being able to stop fighting the regime as they were attacking them, so they were cut off.

At that point Israel stepped in and agreed to continue supplying some Southern Front factions with just enough aid to allow them to sustain their positions (but not more than that) simply because those factions were positioned in & near the southern buffer zone — and if those factions (which were largely comprised of locals who were from that area) could continue to hold that territory then neither ISIS nor Hezbollah/IRGC could advance into it.

But Israel stopped providing those factions with aid in 2017 after they reached a security agreement with Russia re: Southern Syria...
As Russia helped Assad's forces reclaim control over the opposition strongholds in & around Damascus, they began negotiating with rebel factions in the south to wrap things up on those fronts too. Rather than beseiging & bombing them out, as was done in Jobar & Douma — they offered those Southern Front rebel factions reconciliation deals.

Most accepted the offer & took the deal, agreeing to reconcile their statuses with the regime, and upon doing so they were folded back into the SAA, and Russia organized them into the 5th Division & 8th Brigade. They would remain in their positions, continue to be lightly armed, and they would essentially be the regime's armed forces based in the south, where those men & factions would be tasked with defending their communities for the regime. But they had to allow the regime to re-exert control over the south again.

So from 2018 until 2024 the armed forces serving in Assad's SAA 5th Corp & 8th Brigade, based in the south, under Russian oversight — were the same men who'd been in the Southern Front rebel factions fighting in Daraa, Qunietra, parts of Sweida, and southern Damascus countryside all throughout the war...

Point being, the same fighters who'd received aid 1st from the US, and then from Israel, were folded back into Assad's army again in 2018. And from then until December 2024 they technically fought for Assad. (Though, since that front was no longer active they mostly engaged in petty crime like extortion & smuggling. Typical warlord type shit, which is what Assad's armed forces were doing all across the country during the regime's final years. And as the economy grew worse so did their corruption & criminality.)

The few fighters who refused to reconcile were bussed to Idlib. The factions they had been with had fought against Nusra years earlier, so from what I understand those guys just lived as civilians after that, rather than trying to join HTS. (A few did join the SNA stationed at the northern border, because it paid well, though.)

That said, regarding your comment, @RetMeen — NO, those men are NOT holding weapons that came from the occupation army, nor did they receive aid or medical care from Israel. The men you refer to had actually rejoined the SAA back in 2018. 😏

Oh, & Israel provided medical care to a number of Assad's soldiers during the war, too. And they provided medical care to civilians living along the border as well. For about 16 months during the war, from 2013-2015, Israel had a policy in which they'd treat ANYONE who came to the IDF at the border seeking medical care. (They delivered babies & treated sick children too.) But that policy, operation 'Good Neighbor', ended in 2015.

text:
THE NEXT FINANCIAL REVOLUTION

AI Agents, Crypto's Redesign, and the Advance Toward 2030

The next major crypto cycle may be driven not merely by speculation, but by an autonomous machine economy.

AI agents will purchase data, computing power, financial services, and digital assets, increasingly transacting with other agents.

Blockchain could become vital infrastructure for this transformation.

I. NEW FINANCIAL RAILS FOR AI AGENTS

Imagine one million agents making 100 daily payments of $0.01.

That means 100 million transactions and $1 million in daily activity.

This hypothetical example reveals the challenge of machine-scale micropayments.

Coinbase's x402 already enables programmable payment requests and stablecoin settlement.

The technology exists. Mass adoption remains the test.

II. CRYPTO'S NEW ECONOMIC ARCHITECTURE

Different networks perform different functions.

Bitcoin offers scarcity. Ethereum and Solana enable programmable finance. Chainlink supplies external data.

Aave provides lending, Uniswap liquidity, and Avalanche customizable infrastructure.

Injective specializes in on-chain finance and derivatives. Stacks expands Bitcoin-linked applications. Ondo advances tokenized assets.

Cosmos supports interoperability, though ecosystem growth does not guarantee ATOM appreciation.

Together, these networks could support autonomous commerce.

III. SOON: A MODEL FOR AGENT FINANCE

SOON particularly interests me.

Its announced plans combine AI-agent perpetual trading, MCP integration, Phala computing infrastructure, and revenue-funded token buybacks and burns.

The concept connects autonomous trading, blockchain infrastructure, and token economics.

Trading fees could support token demand.

But five questions remain:

Is the platform live? Are agents trading? Is revenue measurable? Are buybacks transparent? Are security controls effective?

SOON's vision is promising. Execution must validate it.

IV. ADOPTION DOES NOT GUARANTEE TOKEN GAINS

Agents may use stablecoins rather than native tokens.

Competition, low fees, and token unlocks can limit returns.

My investment framework:

Real adoption → sustainable activity → measurable token value.

Technological success must produce credible token economics.

V. THE 2030 INVESTMENT THESIS

I respect the optimism of Cathie Wood and Standard Chartered.

Geoff Kendrick's $40,000 Ethereum scenario for 2030 reflects ambitious expectations, not guaranteed returns.

AI has transformed demand for chips, memory, and data centers.

The next wave could reshape machine payments, decentralized liquidity, verified data, and tokenized finance.

Extraordinary crypto returns remain possible, but adoption, revenue, and supply discipline must justify valuations.

VI. AUTONOMY REQUIRES ACCOUNTABILITY

Who authorizes AI trades? Who bears losses? Who stops malfunctioning agents?

Secure credentials, spending limits, auditability, fraud prevention, and human oversight are essential.

Autonomy without accountability cannot sustain trust.

VII. THE GREAT ADVANCE TOWARD 2030

Wars, inflation, geopolitical shocks, and monetary uncertainty will continue to disrupt markets.

But temporary turbulence cannot erase structural technological change.

I remain optimistic about Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Injective, Chainlink, Aave, Uniswap, Avalanche, Stacks, Ondo, and AI-agent finance.

SOON's effort to connect autonomous finance with token value deserves special attention.

Its potential is significant. Execution remains unproven.

Advance with conviction. Demand evidence. Preserve capital.

The strongest army protects its reserves while preparing for the greater campaign.

The machine economy is emerging. Its financial infrastructure could define the next investment era.

The advance toward 2030 has only begun.

— Alan Turing

text:
OttoGeoGraphica
June, 2001
Never Summer Ranch
Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado
(film camera photo)

In the Kawuneeche Valley along the base of the Never Summer Mountains, there is the sight of the Never Summer ranch. A small footbridge crosses the narrow Colorado, the sweet grass is tall, and the deer and elk are plentiful. The ranch, well maintained by the government, sits hidden among lodgepole pines. Old wagons, hitching posts, plank porches and stacked firewood add to the ambiance. Across the divide, Estes, also has old wagons, hitching posts, plank porches and stacked firewood, as well as congestion, boutiques, Porches, and a few Starbucks. The porch swing here is inviting.

The Colorado River trailhead is just before the ascent towards the Farview curve. I take the trail up to Lulu City without venturing into the Neota wilderness. Lulu City, once a booming mining town, has been reclaimed by the land, but the three-mile trek up the northern end of the Kawuneeche, along the ever-narrowing Colorado, at dawn, while campers are still grilling bacon and eggs, offers me a variety of sights and sounds.

The sun has yet to cross the pass, so the air is brisk. A steady pace is the surest way to keep warm. A young raccoon enters the trail, scurries up about ten feet and then off to the left, leaping up and catching hold of a tree. He freezes, stares, and waits for this intruder to pass.

Around any given bend deer munch just off the trail. They look up and pause for they are more curious then startled. A stag, a doe, and a fawn, obviously related, are breakfasting just ahead. The parents, focusing on the shrubbery, continue eating. Only the fawn stops, twitching its fragile wet nose, tweaking one ear, appearing to grant permission to proceed.

Down in the draw a cow moose is resting in the tall river grass. The calf, under the cautious eye of his mother, meanders nearby. The cow, alarmed by the presence of the stranger, stands, and walks at a safe distance back, toward Lulu.

A small sign posts the only acknowledgement that Lulu existed. There are no buildings, no foundations, yet oddly there is a sense a town was once here. The trail crosses a stream. Two boulders strategically placed allow for a dry crossing. Yellow and purple wildflowers grow on its banks. So this is the mighty Colorado. The river responsible for numerous canyons in its home state and Utah, before assisting in the carving of one of the eight natural wonders of the world. The mighty Colorado, whose water assists in the creation of electricity for Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and San Diego. I’m now drinking water near the source and hopscotching back and forth on a journey of innocence: innocent raccoon, innocent fawn, innocent calf, and innocent river.

text:
Colorado finally got both candidates for governor on the same stage today.

Naturally, somebody decided the best way to test their ability to think on their feet was to give them the questions in advance.

Not the topics.

Not a study guide.

The actual questions. Word for word.

Because apparently Colorado’s gubernatorial forum was being administered by the same teacher who leaves the answer key attached to the exam.

To be fair, both candidates received them.

Phil Weiser told reporters afterward that he didn’t ask for the questions and didn’t use them while preparing.

Victor Marx received them too.

Kyle Clark of 9NEWS reported that Marx appeared to be reading prepared, full-sentence answers during the forum.

And there’s now a photo from the event showing Marx looking down at what appears to be a tablet or small laptop on his lap.

So apparently “open-book forum” wasn’t just a metaphor.

Clark was originally announced as the moderator. Clark says the Chamber later removed him in order to secure Marx’s participation, and Ed Sealover moderated instead.

And the Chamber’s explanation evolved during the day too.

First: candidates only received the topics.

Later: yes, they received the exact questions.

So we went from:

“Here’s what you should study.”

to:

“Question 4 is about housing. Your prepared answer is on the tablet.”

All of this would be slightly less ridiculous if this were one of six debates.

It isn’t.

This is currently the only scheduled event where both gubernatorial nominees are expected to share a stage, while Marx has declined moderated debate offers.

So Colorado finally gets its gubernatorial candidates together…

and apparently the solution was to hand everybody the test beforehand and make sure nobody encountered the terrifying possibility of an unexpected question.

Nothing screams executive leadership quite like an open-book final.

text:
Yes study. I’m all for it. Do some! 
James’s statement about works is James 2:14–26, especially 2:17, 2:24, and 2:26. Read in its own argument, it is not a second way of being justified before God. It is a test of whether the faith someone claims is the real thing.

James is writing to scattered believers under trial (1:1–2), and his burden from the start is hearing that does not become doing. The “perfect law of liberty” is a mirror: the one who looks and walks away is not blessed; the doer is (1:22–25). Partiality in the assembly is then named as a violation of “the royal law” and as a failure to live the mercy one claims to have received (2:1–13). Judgment will be without mercy for the one who showed none (2:13). Chapter 2:14 picks up that same thread. It is what to do with a person who says he has faith and has nothing to show for it.

James opens with two questions that expect the answer no: “What good is it, my brothers, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can that faith save him?” (2:14). The faith in view is the faith that person claims (“if someone says”), not faith as Paul defines it. A brother or sister without food or clothing, answered only with “go in peace, be warmed and filled,” shows the problem (2:15–16). Speech that does not act is empty. So “faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead” (2:17).

He then grants the objector’s split: “You have faith and I have works” (2:18). His reply is that faith, if it is real, is shown by works. Bare assent is not enough. “Even the demons believe — and shudder” (2:19). They affirm that God is one, the Shema itself, and it does them no saving good. Orthodox content without trust and obedience is the faith of demons. “Do you want to be shown, you foolish person, that faith apart from works is useless?” (2:20). “Useless” and “dead” describe a faith that cannot produce what it claims, not a living faith that God then supplements with merit.

Abraham is the test case (2:21–23). He “was justified by works when he offered up his son Isaac on the altar.” That event is Genesis 22, decades after Genesis 15:6, where Abraham believed God and it was counted to him as righteousness. James says the offering “completed” his faith, and then quotes Genesis 15:6: the Scripture “was fulfilled.” The offering did not create the reckoning. It brought to visible completion the faith already reckoned. “You see that faith was active along with his works, and faith was completed by his works” (2:22). The works are the working of the faith, not a second instrument beside it. Rahab is the same pattern from the other end of Israel’s story: her sheltering the spies showed that her confession was not talk (2:25).

“You see that a person is justified by works and not by faith alone.” In this paragraph, “justified” means shown to be righteous, vindicated as the real thing, the sense the word often has when the question is evidence before observers (compare Matthew 11:19, “wisdom is justified by her deeds,” and Luke 7:35). “Faith alone” here is the faith James has already defined as bare claim, demon-faith, a corpse. Vs 26 closes the image: “as the body apart from the spirit is dead, so also faith apart from works is dead.” Works are to faith what breath is to a body. They do not replace the body. A body with no breath was never alive.

He is not saying works earn the verdict. James has already called his readers to receive “the implanted word, which is able to save your souls” (1:21), and he treats mercy, not wage, as what triumphs over judgment (2:13). He never says Abraham was justified by works instead of by believing the promise. He says the later act fulfilled the earlier reckoning.
He is also not setting a quota.The works in the passage are the ordinary fruit of the implanted word:care for the naked and hungry, refusal of partiality, obedience when God speaks. “Dead” is aimed at the profession that never moves, not at the weak believer whose fruit is small.

" The Virgin Mary: Mary's Fiat "
by Artist Michael Rucker
copyright ©

Description
The Virgin Mary: Mary's fiat -
In the Gospel of Luke, chapter 1, verses 26-38 (KJV), the angel Gabriel appears to Mary, a young virgin betrothed to Joseph of the house of David in Nazareth. Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee, the angel declares. He announces that she will conceive and bear a son, Jesus, who shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest. Mary, troubled yet reverent, asks how this can be since she knows not a man. Gabriel explains the Holy Spirit will come upon her; for with God nothing shall be impossible.

Mary's response is one of the most profound moments in Scripture the only recorded instance where she speaks words of total surrender: Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word (Luke 1:38). This Latin phrase, Fiat mihi secundum verbum tuum (Let it be done to me according to your word), is universally known as Mary's Fiat. In that single sentence she offers her entire being body, will, and future to Gods plan of salvation. The angel then departs, and the Incarnation begins.This humble virgin from an obscure village becomes the mother of the Messiah. She travels to visit her cousin Elizabeth (pregnant with John the Baptist), where she sings the Magnificat (Luke 1:46-55), a soaring hymn of praise that magnifies the Lord for lifting up the lowly.

She gives birth to Jesus in Bethlehem, wraps Him in swaddling clothes, and lays Him in a manger. She ponders the shepherds and Magis words in her heart (Luke 2:19, 51). At the Presentation in the Temple, Simeon foretells a sword will pierce her soul (Luke 2:35). She is present at the wedding in Cana, prompting Jesus first miracle (John 2:1-11), and stands at the foot of the cross, where the dying Savior entrusts her to the beloved disciple (John 19:25-27).

After the Ascension, she is seen praying with the apostles in the upper room, awaiting the Holy Spirit (Acts 1:14).Scripture portrays Mary not as a distant saint but as a real woman of extraordinary faith, courage, and obedience. Though the Bible does not record many of her words, her fiat echoes through salvation history as the perfect model of human cooperation with divine grace. She exemplifies what it means to say yes to God when the cost is everything.Your striking black-and-white artwork beautifully captures this very moment: Mary veiled, head bowed, hands clasped in prayerful surrender, her flowing hair and garments stirred by the unseen wind of the Spirit.

The dramatic lighting and ethereal atmosphere evoke the solemn hush of the Annunciation the instant heaven touched earth through a virgins willing heart. It is a powerful visual meditation on Luke 1:38, inviting viewers to contemplate the same radical trust Mary offered.

📉 MARKET CLOSE | OCT 8

AI stocks got hit hard, but the broader market held up better than the indexes suggest.

$SPX -0.47%
Nasdaq -1.25%
Dow +0.10%
Russell 2000 flat

Semis -3.4%, yet two-thirds of S&P stocks finished green. Energy led, tech lagged.

Oil surged on Iran tanker attacks + hurricane disruptions:
WTI +3.6% to $91.49
Brent +4.1% to $104.28

Bonds were volatile again. The 10Y hit 5.35% before falling back to ~5.23% after a strong Treasury auction. Dollar slipped, gold +0.4%.

Jobless claims stayed low at 197K. Fed’s Waller still sees more hikes, with December hike odds around 69%.

AI took the biggest hit:
$NVDA -2.9%
$AVGO -4.4%
$MU -4.8%
$ORCL -5.5%

Concerns over AI revenue expectations and debt-funded expansion weighed on tech.

Elsewhere:
$PEP +3.7% on earnings
$CMG +6.2% on takeover speculation
$PLTR +2.4% after an upgrade

Bottom line: AI weakness is dragging the indexes despite decent breadth. Oil above $100 Brent and elevated yields keep inflation/Fed risks alive. Bond demand offered some relief, but expensive AI stocks now need earnings to back up their valuations.

text:
my TL is full of BCI (particularly non invasive read/write), but no one with a concrete set of futures we can agree on

i offer:

emotion airdrop, the capacity to share feelings between friends, and for artists to craft multimedia experiences via "Palette", a service acting as a paintbrush for emotion. films should be able to make you feel things you would rarely reach yourself, like joy alongside melancholy, and accentuate certain emotions you are already feeling. to feel the deepest love, the greatest pain, and truly empathise with your peers and your culture. it is hard to imagine an in group/ out group dynamic surviving such close sharing of feeling.

a sense of pushing against the edge of your mind, BCIs should not be predictive, they should require you actively "press into" the digital world, in a way that feels akin to a swipe on an iPhone. a simple action but one that is not made on your behalf, one that requires you make an active effort. if BCIs are predictive and decode your desires before you are aware of them, you won't have the sensation of having consciously requested something, moreso that it unearthed some desire that you may not even have yet been confident about: casting your thoughts into action too prematurely. the BCI cannot impinge on your sense of self and feel like a dark cloud inside of your finite consciousness, it should let you push into the digital abyss and expand your being.

minimally invasive approaches that extend cognition,  society has a natural disposition against plastic surgery and dispositions against invasive BCI, surgeries that would seem for vanity if purely for human-computer interaction. biohybrid BCIs give us the capacity to have brain systems that we "grow into" via axonal arborisation, making them societally easier to accept, and provide a read/write modality much denser than ultrasound based stimulation/readout. we need that density if we want to expand cognition, to provide a maximal bandwidth information channel into an external substrate that our consciousness fills. we're computationally limited. we need BCI to help unchain those biological limits.

solving the coordination problem of society, rather than agents representing us, we can represent ourselves in every domain where we are required, outputting our thoughts at scales that would be unreachable via verbal communication alone. human thought can sit before a tool call, tool AI downstream of man without replacing human agency. that requires scaling cognition, scaling read-write throughout, and might be impossible without invasive BCI.

but if executed well, could mean the resolution of conflict at a scale that is hard to imagine, the perfect transfer of information between one mind and another, including intuitional sensibility and that internal confidence one might feel around their views which only a lifetime of experience in a field can produce. seeing so much validity across heterogeneous views will enable true plurality in a way that we struggle with currently, where society wants a one-hot vector output of right/wrong over a floating-point value. if we can share enough, quickly and at scale, we might finally understand each other as a species.

a lot of my recent thinking currently comes from discussions with @thryambakg on our drive a few weeks back from Santa Barbara to SF. 

there are more thoughts i will be sharing in the coming weeks on a canonical vision for the future and maintaining human agency within it.

we must rage against those who wake up without a love for their lives, and force them to live their lives fully. to choose for themselves what they want in existence. to prevent algorithms from deciding the fate of humanity.

we must build a future organised around pointing to the Heavens, stressing a correct direction of pursuit over avoiding fates. we will never win by being EAs scared of downside, we must select the outcomes we wish for.

text:
The Origins of AI 16: The Second AI Winter - Why Did the First AI That Actually Made Money Help Push the Industry Toward Collapse?

[16-1] Once AI Finally Started Making Money, Everyone Began to Believe It Would Keep Winning

By the middle of the 1980s, artificial intelligence looked completely different from the field that had entered its first winter a decade earlier. During the earlier collapse in confidence, one of the central questions had been whether AI would ever become genuinely useful. Now some companies could point to financial statements and show that it already was. DEC's XCON expert system was helping configure complex VAX computer orders, reducing mistakes and expensive rework, and was estimated to save the company tens of millions of dollars every year. Banks, insurers, manufacturers, mining companies, and medical organizations were experimenting with expert systems of their own, while a new generation of companies appeared to sell AI software, development environments, and knowledge-engineering services.

This was the first true commercial boom in the history of AI. In the 1950s and 1960s, researchers often had to demonstrate theorem proving, chess, robotics, or language experiments to persuade outsiders that intelligent machines might someday matter. By the 1980s, a corporate executive could simply look at a cost sheet. If an expert system cost a few million dollars to build but saved tens of millions over its lifetime, AI was no longer merely an interesting research project. It had become an investment with a measurable return. That change transformed the mood of the industry. Companies created internal AI groups, consultants searched for business processes that could be turned into knowledge systems, and expert-system shells made it possible to build new applications without recreating an entire reasoning engine from scratch.

AI even created its own specialized hardware industry. LISP had long been one of the most important languages in American AI research because it was well suited to symbolic processing, lists, dynamic data structures, and interactive programming. Large LISP environments, however, placed heavy demands on the memory management and processing capabilities of early general-purpose computers. Companies such as Symbolics, Lisp Machines Inc., and Texas Instruments therefore built workstations specifically optimized for LISP and AI development. These machines were expensive, but they offered remarkably advanced programming environments for the time. Researchers could modify running programs, inspect complex objects, debug rule systems, and test new ideas interactively. To an AI engineer in the early 1980s, a high-end LISP machine could feel less like an ordinary computer and more like a ticket into the most advanced software laboratory in the world.

A complete industrial ecosystem began to form around this success. Universities trained AI researchers, knowledge engineers interviewed domain experts, software companies sold expert-system tools, businesses bought specialized AI workstations, and entire professional workflows were transformed into rule bases. The first AI winter seemed to be over, and this time the excitement was supported by real customers, real contracts, and real savings rather than only predictions about the future.

That success created a dangerous assumption. When a technology has never worked, people are usually cautious. When it works spectacularly in a few places, the temptation is to assume that the same formula can simply be copied everywhere. Just as American companies were beginning to imagine expert systems spreading across entire industries, Japan announced something even more ambitious. It did not merely want to build better expert systems. It wanted to redefine the computer itself.

text:
The accusations against Paxton are savage and false.  John Cornyn's willingness to use these false allegations in his campaign and support them for Talarico is despicable.  

This is what GROK says:  

The accusation is about a real plea deal, not a personal pardon or release by Ken Paxton. The case is Adam Dean Hoffman, a Waco lawyer. Paxton was not the trial lawyer, and both the defense and the line prosecutors have said he did not negotiate the deal. The lenient outcome is still real, and it is the part his opponents are using.

**How the case reached the Attorney General**

Hoffman was arrested in 2022 and charged with continuous sexual abuse of a child, a first-degree felony that can carry life. The allegation was that he abused a boy, his son’s friend, from about April 2019 to April 2022, beginning when the child was about 6 or 7.

McLennan County District Attorney Josh Tetens recused himself because Hoffman had sought his legal advice before Tetens took office. The case was then referred to the Office of the Attorney General. Under *State v. Stephens* (2021), the Texas AG cannot independently prosecute a criminal case in a trial court without a local prosecutor’s request or deputization. This was a conflict referral, not a case Paxton chose.

**What happened in court**

The AG’s office tried the case over four days in June 2025. The jury hung 7–5 for conviction, and the judge declared a mistrial.

Prosecutors Brenda Cantu and Dorian Cotlar (29 and 25 years of experience; Cotlar is board-certified in criminal law) said the child would not voluntarily testify again. They wrote Rep. Jeff Leach that the only way to retry the felony was to subpoena the child and put him through a second cross-examination, and that without his testimony they had no path to prove the felony elements. Cantu told the court there is no system in which anyone tells them what to do on their cases.

In April 2026 Hoffman pleaded guilty to two misdemeanors: indecent assault and displaying harmful material to a minor. In the judicial confession he admitted touching the child’s genitals with intent to arouse or gratify sexual desire, without consent.

The first offer was one day in jail. Judge Roy Sparkman rejected that. A revised deal of 30 days plus surrender of the law license was discussed. At sentencing the boy’s mother said it was not enough and that Hoffman was dangerous. The judge imposed 60 days, a five-year law-license surrender, and a lifetime protective order. Hoffman was released from the McLennan County Jail on May 25, 2026, after 29 days, under the county’s good-time credit. The reduced charges did not require Texas sex-offender registration. Later reporting says the Texas Supreme Court canceled his law license on July 2, 2026, and that he moved to Nebraska, where the conviction requires 15 years on that state’s registry.

**Paxton’s personal role**

Hoffman’s lawyer, Gerry Morris, told the Texas Tribune and Newsweek that Paxton had nothing to do with the negotiations, that Morris never communicated with him about the case, never saw any sign he was involved, and has never met him. Morris, who described himself as a lifelong Democrat, called the special-treatment claim false and said misdemeanor pleas after weak or hung child-sex cases are not unusual. The prosecutors’ letter to Leach is the office’s formal explanation; it rests on the hung jury and the child’s refusal to retestify, not on a directive from Paxton.

Paxton later defended the outcome in campaign settings by saying the criticism that he “let a child predator out after one day” was wrong because the judge imposed 60 days, the jury had split, and the office chose not to force the child back on the stand. That defense blurs two facts: his prosecutors did offer the one-day deal, and the 60 days was the judge’s number, of which Hoffman served 29.

**The political charge**

John Cornyn used the deal against Paxton in the 2026 Republican primary. Democrat James Talarico has run ads calling it an “Epstein-style sweetheart deal” and labeling Paxton a “pedophile protector.” PolitiFact rated the narrower claim that Paxton’s office “let Hoffman off the hook” Mostly True: a man charged with a life felony who admitted the touching received misdemeanors, under a month in jail, and no Texas registry. PolitiFact also noted the hung jury and the victim’s refusal to testify again, which the ads omit.

Tetens has said publicly that his office did not prosecute the case and that he shares the concern over how it ended. No court record or on-the-record statement from either side’s lawyers shows Paxton personally directed the plea. The accurate criticism is of a lenient resolution by lawyers in his office after a 7–5 mistrial, not of Paxton releasing a pedophile himself.

Aurinia Pharmaceuticals is preparing to leave its approximately 31,000-square-foot Rockville headquarters years before its lease expires in 2031.

The Canadian drugmaker says it expects to exercise a 2028 early-termination option costing $1.4 million or potentially sublease the space sooner.

The move follows major restructuring:

80 Rockville employees laid off in 2024.
Companywide workforce fell from 300 to 130.
New CEO Kevin Tang replaced longtime CEO Peter Greenleaf in March.

When Aurinia established its Rockville headquarters in 2020, Maryland offered a $2 million loan, Montgomery County provided a $700,000 grant, and Rockville contributed another $50,000 grant.

The company initially projected potentially employing up to 500 workers by 2027.

Now, with the company preparing to exit, a key taxpayer question remains: What happened to those economic development incentives, and were the promised jobs ever delivered?

text:
Rep. Brandon Gill is right to call for ending H-1B. Washington shows why.
Microsoft (Redmond) and Amazon (Seattle) are the state’s top H-1B filers. In FY2025 they submitted thousands of labor condition applications for Washington worksites alone—Microsoft about 6,200, https://t.co/CWTrrpSgmO Services about 7,600—while both have cut U.S. jobs.
Today the Trump administration suspended Microsoft (and others) from the PERM green-card program. VP Vance said Microsoft laid off roughly 6,000 American workers last year while securing about 6,300 H-1B visas and nearly 3,000 green cards. “For every worker Microsoft laid off, they replaced that worker with 1½ foreign indentured servants.”
King County already lost domestic residents and local jobs while international hiring continued. Specialty visas were meant to fill shortages Americans can’t fill—not to run a parallel workforce next to layoffs in Redmond and Seattle. End the program.
Slightly longer version:
Washington is ground zero for H-1B. Microsoft and Amazon, both headquartered here, lead the state in labor-condition filings. DOL data for FY2025 show https://t.co/CWTrrpSgmO Services filed 7,608 LCAs for Washington worksites (avg. offered wage ~$155k) and Microsoft 6,237 (~$174k). Microsoft alone accounted for roughly 5,900 of those in Redmond.
That pipeline has continued alongside cuts. Microsoft’s recent Xbox reductions and broader layoffs hit Washington workers. Amazon has also filed WARN notices for Washington roles. The contrast is what the administration cited today: VP Vance said Microsoft laid off about 6,000 American workers last year while benefiting from roughly 6,300 H-1B visas and almost 3,000 green cards, and Labor suspended Microsoft, Adobe, and several outsourcing firms from PERM.
H-1B was sold as a temporary tool for skills Americans lack. In practice, Washington’s largest employers use it at scale in software and related roles while the region has seen job losses outside the pandemic era and King County has gained population mainly through international migration, not domestic moves. Seattle’s metro share of H-1B work has long been several times its share of private-sector jobs.
Microsoft says most recent petitions were extensions or transfers, not brand-new arrivals, and that new filings are a small share of its U.S. headcount. Even on that account, the program locks in a large non-citizen workforce and a green-card path while Americans in the same state are being laid off. That is the abuse Gill and the administration are describing. Congress should end H-1B, not tweak it.

- 🛢️ Energy Market Support: Stronger crude oil prices supported vegetable oils. Brent rose 4.07% to $104.28/bbl, while WTI gained 3.12% to $91.03/bbl, amid US Gulf production disruptions caused by Hurricane Isaias and Middle East tensions.
- 🇨🇳 Chinese Oils Mixed: Dalian palm olein futures fell 0.88% to CNY9,509/tonne, and soybean oil declined 0.31% to CNY8,906/tonne. Zhengzhou rapeseed oil gained 0.32% to CNY10,250/tonne.
- 🇺🇸 Soybean Oil Recovers: CME December soybean oil futures rose 0.35% to 67.92 cents/lb, tracking stronger crude oil, while soybean futures fell 0.77% to $12.87/bushel.
- 🚢 US Soybean Oil Exports Weak: Accumulated soybean oil shipments reached 367,700 tonnes, down 66% year on year. Weekly soybean oil sales for 2026/27 totalled 9,300 tonnes, with an additional 8,100 tonnes carried over from the previous marketing year.
- 🇦🇷 Argentina Soybean Outlook Improves: USDA's Buenos Aires attaché raised its 2026/27 soybean production forecast to 52.5 million tonnes, up 8% from the previous estimate, and projected soybean crushing at 44.8 million tonnes.
- 🇮🇳 India Buying Activity Slows: Higher CPO futures lifted Indian import offers. CPO was offered at $1,235/tonne CFR WCI for October and $1,225/tonne CFR ECI for November. Soybean oil offers also strengthened, reaching $1,315/tonne CFR WCI for October–December shipment.
- 🌻 Sunflower Oil Remains Firm: Black Sea tensions and elevated shipping risks supported prices. Indian trades were reported at $1,470/tonne CIF LW for November shipment and $1,440–1,445/tonne for December–January.
- 🇪🇺 European Oils Strengthen: Euronext February 2027 rapeseed futures rose €6.50 to €559.25/tonne. European rapeseed and sunflower oil prices remained supported by strength across the vegetable oils complex and regional supply risks.
- 🌎 South American Soybean Oil Bases Edge Higher: November soybean oil basis strengthened to discounts of 13.25 cents/lb in Argentina and 12.8 cents/lb in Brazil against December futures, despite subdued trading activity.
- 📉 Soybean Meal Weakens: CME December soybean meal futures fell 2.24% to $357.60/short ton, pressured by weakness in the broader grain complex.
🔎 Market Outlook
Bullish factors: Firmer crude oil, stronger related vegetable oils, potential Malaysian export tax relief, and Black Sea supply risks.
Bearish factors: Elevated Malaysian palm oil inventories, weak Chinese palm and soybean oil futures, and subdued Indian buying.
Key market focus: Malaysia’s Budget 2027 announcement on 9 October, inventory data, crude oil movements, and developments affecting Black Sea and US Gulf supplies.

text:
HMS Implacable (R86) was a British Royal Navy aircraft carrier, the lead ship of the Implacable class, built during World War II. She entered service in August 1944 and was one of the last generations of large armored carriers the Royal Navy designed for the conflict. 

The class kept the British habit of an armored flight deck, trading some hangar volume for resistance to bombs, and then recovered capacity that the earlier Illustrious ships had given up: a fully two-level hangar, more aircraft, and enough speed to operate with the fleet.

A curious fact about this class of carriers is that the Implacable class is considered to have arrived too late to decisively influence the war, yet they were also among the best British aircraft carriers of the World War II, combining speed, protection, and an aircraft capacity superior to that of the Illustrious class.

Implacable spent her time during the conflict sidelined, in Norway, then the Pacific, then the scrapyard in the 1950s. 

Withint the game, she describes her as such: an improved Illustrious class carrier who, like many late arrivals, appears only in a corner of the finale of the tale.

There is nothing in the game that directly explains what inspired Implacable's design or personality based on the aircraft carrier story. The HMS Implacable (R86) was simply an armored fleet carrier with no particular connection to religion, chastity, or anything resembling the themes that define her in-game characterization.

You may wonder where the devs drew their inspiration when creating her character. And it appears that her characterization was influenced more by the factions she belongs to than by the historical ship itself.

Within Azur Lane, the Royal Navy often employs imagery associated with monarchy, ceremony, knights, cathedrals, choirs, and religious symbolism, similar to the Iris Orthodoxy faction.

Queen Elizabeth occupies a position that is more than merely administrative, the shipgirls often use language that elevates Queen Elizabeth beyond an ordinary monarch. She functions simultaneously as a political ruler, national symbol, their source of unity and almost a near-sacred figure.

Queen Elizabeth isn't a literal deity, but the Royal Navy's collective piety is directed at Queen Elizabeth as both sovereign and quasi-divine figure in her leadership.

As a result, Implacable can be understood as the most overtly religious expression of themes that already exist elsewhere in the faction.

In that sense, her nun-like appearance visually externalizes ideas that are already present throughout the Royal Navy characters.

These factors were probably considered when planning the character to give her a unique characterization and appearance within the great variety of characters you can find in this faction, since the religious inspiration (and more specifically, the aesthetic of a nun) is present both in the character's attire and in her rigging.

Even so, this aproaching is quite ironic, because Implacable doesn't actually believes in anything related to religion, the only devotion she has is towards her faction, Her Majesty, and later, the Commander.

In the Japanese text of her introduction (which, the English account didn't bother to post) describes her as an improved Illustrious class armored carrier who is detached and unflappable, wrapped in a bewitching air, and hardly the woman one would call an elegant lady. 

She has no faith. She still reaches constantly for pious phrasing, because she is the type who enjoys the feeling of transgression and immorality.

In traditional Catholic morality, lust is considered a sin, and this applies both to nuns and to any other Catholic.

Nuns, by taking a vow of chastity, specially commit themselves to living without romantic or sexual relationships and to orienting their lives toward their religious vocation. But they remain human beings, so they can experience attraction, desires, or temptations. The difference lies in how they respond to them.

Implacable, as I said, does not believe in these things and is not bound by these beliefs. Nevertheless, she practices them because she enjoys that feeling of immorality that comes from appearing to be a devout nun, while at the same time imposing no chains on herself so that she can give free rein to her desires.

She enjoys that contradiction between what she appears to be and what she truly is.

Her name describes her well: someone who shows no mercy or compassion, who cannot be appeased, and who stops at nothing. That is what it means to be Implacable, and this also applies to her lustful side, because her desires are similarly unappeased.

Implacable has no chains to break, and while she is more or less discreet about her perverted side, she still has no one toward whom she can direct all those desires she possesses, which is why she finds herself "repressed" in a certain sense. 

What Implacable lacks is a person who will receive that gap without punishing it or demanding that she pick one side.

She waits and longs to find someone who will accept those thoughts, desires, feelings, and expectations. Or in other words, she is without an appropriate outlet for them.

What she needs is someone who can see both sides of her and not demand that one of them disappear.

She has desires that she is perfectly willing to acknowledge privately, but there isn't necessarily someone she trusts enough to whom she can expose the whole of that side of herself. So, her "repression" is partly social and relational rather than theological.

And this makes the Commander's role especially important.

The Commander, as we well know, within the world of Azur Lane, is a neutral authority who mediates between the different factions, and also someone the shipgirls can turn to thanks to this neutral position.

That makes him an unusually appropriate person for Implacable.

The Commander’s role here is important not only because it is reciprocal toward her feelings or because he accepts everything of what defines Implacable, but also because, according to Implacable, he is someone who represses his own desires, or rather, someone who represses his "shadow".

The "shadow" is an archetype from analytical psychology that represents the dark side of the psyche. It encompasses all the aspects, desires, emotions, impulses, and talents that a person rejects, represses, or does not recognize as their own because they do not fit with their conscious self-image or with social norms.

It can be what we understood as a "social mask", built from early childhood, when we learn which behaviors are accepted and which are punished or frowned upon, sending them into the unconscious (lust being a prime example).

Lust does not necessarily lead to sin, or in other words, to the corruption of the self.

It is not enjoyable to be a slave to one's thoughts; put another way, it is not mentally healthy to fervently repress desires that form part of one’s "self", such as, sexual desires in this case in particular.

The dynamic between Implacable and the Commander is a constant push and pull, with Implacable helping the Commander to accept his own desires, because if she accepts all of her with no conditions and no price, the honest answer is to accept, and the latter resisting that temptation.

Implacable is someone who is unusually comfortable looking directly at the parts of herself that other people might prefer to hide, her "shadow". And consequently, she can recognize those same characteristics in the Commander, therefore, someone more than fitting to help him with his inhibition.

With Implacable's help, he manages to integrate his "shadow" into his life, without letting it dictate everything he does, and without letting the "shadow" completely take over the “self.”

There is a curious detail in her "Start Mission" voice line before and after oathing Implacable.

Before proposing marriage to Implacable, she carries out her missions in the name of Queen Elizabeth.

After the marriage, Implacable begins to carry out her missions in the name of the primary object of her personal devotion: the Commander, while Queen Elizabeth remains the object of her institutional and national loyalty.

And this change is quite evident in the interactions between Implacable and the Commander after the oath. Implacable seems less inhibited and leads a fuller life now that she finally has someone with whom she can release all those desires she previously had "repressed" to some degree.

Implacable and the Commander relationship has a natural psychological symmetry.

She can look at something in him and say "You don't have to pretend that this part of you doesn't exist".

And he can provide what she lacks: someone who accepts the part of her that she has already acknowledged but has never had a suitable relationship in which to express.

Implacable can be understood as a person who managed to integrate the "shadow" of her persona into her everyday life without letting it dictate her convictions or how she should live. And in her relationship with the Commander, she found someone willing to accept everything she has to offer.

She continues to uphold her personal values, loyalty, and conviction, while allowing herself to express the romantic and physical needs she once sought a partner for, becoming a more complete and authentic version of herself.

She was already Implacable, but her relationship with the Commander gives that "Implacability" of hers somewhere to belong.

By law, to keep money that the state gets for each child that lives and goes to school there, the judge could force the child to move to NC but she couldn’t legally or constitutionally force me to move.

Not giving me visitation with the child I raised on my own without his help and without him giving one cent to take care of her because he needed that money for drugs, was and still is fully unconstitutional and illegal.

text:
I bless thee  Copeland in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore his body completely. Remove all heart problems, kidney problems and failure, genetic disorders, strokes, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew his strength, energy, and vitality.Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to his heart. Surround him with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure him. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part   Copeland’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of heart problems, leukemia, genetic disorders, kidney problems and failure cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround    Copeland with Your gentle light, while completely healing    Copeland while filling his heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal from all heart problems, leukemia, genetic disorders, injuries, cancer and diseases, and protect   Copeland—and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

Prayer for Surgery (In case needed.)

Lord Almighty, I lift up this beloved one   Copeland, as he faces surgery. Protect him, guide the hands of doctors and nurses, and grant wisdom in every decision. Remove fear, anxiety, and complications, replacing them with Your peace and assurance. Restore his health, strength, and vitality quickly, and surround them with Your loving presence. Comfort his heart, strengthen their spirit, and let Your healing flow through  Copeland’s body. May he recover fully, trusting Your mercy and experiencing Your grace throughout this trial. Amen.

Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon  Copeland. Strengthen him to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon  Copeland. Strengthen him to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant  Copeland a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

Lord Jesus, we come to you with faith and ask you to cover us with your precious blood. Lord, grant us your healing peace. Amen.

Hail, holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To you do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us; and after this, our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of your womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

Immaculate Mother of God, Our Lady of Lourdes, you chose to appear in a desolate grotto to a simple child. We come to you with boundless confidence to implore your intercession. Look upon us with your merciful eyes, especially upon  Copeland who suffers from leukemia and is ill. Obtain for him the healing and relief that we seek, and above all, grant us the strength to accept God’s perfect will. Amen. a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

Beyond its scenic backdrop, the beauty of these waters also comes with a responsibility to protect them. Solea Reef is taking steps toward marine ecosystem conservation through continued consultations with experts, with hopes of helping create a safer coastal environment where sea turtles can thrive and hatchlings may one day find a protected passage to the sea. 

Here, the resort’s vision extends beyond intimate hospitality — to becoming part of a wider effort to preserve the natural treasures that make Anda extraordinary.
